newsitem.title: USA: Nationsbank to acquire Montgomery Securities.
newsitem.headline: Nationsbank to acquire Montgomery Securities.

text.p: NationsBank Corp. said on Monday it agreed to acquire closely held investment bank Montgomery Securities for $1.2 billion in the latest combination of a commercial bank and a brokerage house.

Montgomery will retain substantial autonomy, the two companies said, and will become part of NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc., a subsidiary that will be renamed NationsBanc Montgomery Securities Inc. Thomas Weisel, chief executive of Montgomery, will become chairman of the unit.
San Francisco-based Montgomery, which specialises in high technology firms, had made no secret of its plans over the past two months to sell a stake in order to grow the business.
"The combination of our two companies is a great fit and will allow us to reach our goal of providing one-stop shopping to our clients," Weisel said in a statement.
The purchase will be paid for with a combination of 70 percent cash and 30 percent stock.

Under the pact, NationsBank said it will create a $100 million pool for the long-term retention of key Montgomery non-partner personnel. Half of the funding for the pool will be in stock options and the rest cash.
NationsBanc Capital Markets is registered as a broker-dealer with the Securities and Exchange Commission with about $534 million in regulatory capital, NationsBank said.
The deal, subject to regulatory approvals, is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
NationsBank stock added 50 cents to $65.75 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
